E0322

Assignment `=` in `if` condition — did you mean `==`? (D-ASSIGNCOND1)

What

Assignment `=` in `if` condition — did you mean `==`? (D-ASSIGNCOND1)

Why

The registered parse rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0322

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0322: tests/ui/assign_in_condition.stderr.

Error [E0322]: assignment `=` cannot appear in an `if` condition
  --> tests/ui/assign_in_condition.jet:3:10
    |
  3 |     if x = 10 {
    |          ^
 Why: `=` binds a name; use `==` to compare two values
 Fix: replace `=` with `==` to compare, or move the assignment before the `if`
